# Weekly mission brief template

- Brief ID/week/pillar:
- Status: `DRAFT | IN_REVIEW | APPROVED_FOR_RECORDING | RECORDED | PUBLISHED | REJECTED`
- Approver: Daniel Monoga
- Extra production budget: 180 minutes

## Mission
- Audience problem / honest promise / alternate viewpoint / why now / viewer result:

## Grounding
- External source channel + video ID/URL + raw observation timestamp:

- Source phrasing/structure/examples that must not be copied:

## Original episode structure
1. Real problem and stakes.
2. Sanitized evidence.
3. Decision/tradeoff and failed obvious approach.
4. Smallest useful build/demo.
5. Natural “turn it around” viewpoint.
6. Result, limits, unknowns.
7. One viewer action to verify.

## Recording and derivatives
- A-roll / screen or physical shots / evidence overlays / claims to verify / target duration:
- Standalone Short 1 / failure-decision Short 2 / community question:

## Approval checklist
- [ ] Internal data is sanitized/demo-only.
- [ ] No third-party video/transcript was downloaded or scraped.
- [ ] Source phrasing, structure, examples, and thumbnails were not copied.
- [ ] Claims have evidence or are labeled hypothesis.
- [ ] Brief fits the 180-minute budget.
- [ ] Daniel explicitly approved publication.
